description: Via: passes a polyphonic cable straight through so that SIM expanders can change the channels on the way

inputs.text: The channels to be passed through; they are the buffer the expanders work on

outputs.text: The channels after every expander in the chain has had its turn

notes: expanders are placed touching this module, input expanders on the left and output expanders on the right; the Add Expander item on the menu places a compatible one on the correct side
with no expander attached this module changes nothing at all; it exists to give ReX, InX and OutX something to work on
the buffer here holds voltages, so InX adds and OutX cuts values rather than combining gates

inputs.0:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads no channels.
